notes: The only image is a boot-jumper diagram of the RAK5005-O base board (RAK11200 mounted), not a pin map of the RAK11200 itself. It shows unlabeled header holes (silkscreen J10/J11/J12 partially visible); only two pads are called out (BOOT0 and GND, to be shorted with a jumper). Individual pin labels for the headers are not printed, so no connector map can be transcribed.
